# Feasibility experiment — [title]

Status: proposed / approved / running / completed / inconclusive
Related decision/task: [IDs] · Date: [date]

## Hypothesis

One measurable uncertainty, e.g. “this voice meets Urdu pronunciation targets” or “this worker processes a 128 GB source within bounded scratch.”

## Constraints and authorization

Maximum spend; allowed providers/resources; rights-cleared fixture; confidentiality/data-use review; cancellation/cleanup plan; explicit approver.

## Setup

Repository/image version, account/region/tier, provider/model/voice/prompt/rate versions, fixture duration/size/codec/hash, worker resources, concurrency. No credentials.

## Procedure and success criteria

Exact steps, metrics, thresholds, repetitions, negative/fault cases. Separate observed results from projections.

## Results

Actual usage/cost, duration, resource peaks, quality scores, failures, output hashes/evidence. If no call/test ran, state “not executed.”

## Conclusion

Supported / rejected / inconclusive; limitations; next decision; cleanup confirmation. One short success does not establish 24-hour reliability.
